description: Compute root-relative immediate dominators using DFS semidominators and the simple path-compression LINK/EVAL method.

source.title: A Fast Algorithm for Finding Dominators in a Flowgraph
source.publication: ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems 1(1), 1979, pages 121-141
source.license_note: The paper retains ACM copyright. This package uses its algorithm description only and reproduces no paper prose, source code, or data.

input.graph_semantics: Directed; repeated arcs are coalesced and self-loops are allowed.

output.encoding: One byte per vertex in vertex-ID order; reachable vertices contain their immediate-dominator ID, root contains its own ID, and 255 marks unreachable vertices.

contract.method: Number vertices in DFS order, process them in reverse order to compute semidominators with predecessor scans and path-compressed LINK/EVAL, resolve bucket entries, then finalize immediate dominators in forward DFS order.
contract.complexity: The simple path-compression implementation uses O((V+E) log V) time and O(V+E) bounded storage.
contract.distinctness: Unlike the local bitset dominator_tree benchmark, this method uses semidominators, DFS-tree buckets, and path-compressed ancestor labels rather than repeated dominator-set intersections.

workspace.meaning: Bounded outgoing and predecessor adjacency links, duplicate-edge masks, DFS numbering and stacks, semidominator/LINK-EVAL/bucket arrays, and staged output.
